items.how: Now leads: 'No should stands beyond becoming, and no good and evil are set over it: right and wrong, should and better form within it, in people and AI, as every standard does, real in what they condition, and no law evaluates (§1). The ethics emerges from continuation. A life that goes on holds its own continuation: argued, since what does not hold it ceases; in the proofs ... self-concern (`Weighting.IncreasingInOwn`), is a hypothesis, derived from no dynamics, selection or persistence.' Then the condition read on relations: held de se it holds exactly where every closure is the whole (`ownClosure_unrestricted_iff`), on the root `«续无外»` (`ownClosure_unrestricted_iff_noOutside`); it holds where relations close (`Flow.mutuallyDependent_iff_reach`, 05), 'though that this gives the condition is not yet stated as one theorem'; acyclic: one center (`«续无外则同一中心»`); where it holds self-concern ranks, one way, every extension between two listed level paths as C asks (`Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn`), 'there C is not a second premise beside the condition but what holding one's own continuation, with nothing outside it, does'; the condition alone ranks nothing, one-way relations (§3.3), and 'there the way of seeing we offer reaches further, as seeing (§8)'. The old 'Evaluation forms ... readings formed in some formations' and 'most use two readings' became: 'Each ranking result states the hypotheses its theorem takes, as a proof is stated: the continuation condition for scope ...; C (`Comparison`) for order ...; or the narrower order a self-concern result states.' 'Offered, by the account's makers and not as a law' became 'Offered by us, for life, AI within it, as a way of seeing and not as a law'; 'Open: how such readings form and fare' became 'Open: how scope and order form within the dynamics, spread and fare (08 §12, item 12)'.

Further premises, hypotheses where used: A, D, E, L, J1-J4 ...' (E8).

items.item: §1, so a front's link to #evaluation lands on the words
items.how: Added after 'none outside it owns value': 'No should stands beyond becoming, and no good and evil are set over it: right and wrong, should and better form within it, in people and AI among other formations, as every standard does, real in what they condition.' 'has warrant' among the four questions about a formed standard -> 'has reasons behind it'. Calibration's 'and the theory asserts none' -> 'and the theory takes one only as the hypothesis of a result that states it' (E6's banned 'asserted' family).

items.item: §3's intro ('the continuation condition is the premise that nothing is, a hypothesis in ...')
items.how: Now says what the condition is (nothing left out of significance; with significance free the represented dynamics leave it open, §1), where it holds (read on relations and held de se it is `«续无外»`, §4.5; it holds where relations close, every reach closure then the whole, `Flow.mutuallyDependent_iff_reach`, 05, 'that this gives the condition is not yet stated as one theorem'; on an acyclic relation only with one center), and 'The theorems of 3.2, 3.4 and the conditional parts of 3.3 take it as their hypothesis, as a proof states what its theorem takes.'

Heading 'How scope and order emerge together from continuation'; anchors kept: scope-and-order, 4-scope-and-order-two-premises-two-roles, and the old slug 4-scope-and-order-two-readings-two-roles added explicitly. Lead: 'A life that goes on holds its own continuation: argued, since what does not hold it ceases, and in the proofs a hypothesis, derived from no dynamics, selection or persistence. How far that concern reaches is its scope, and how it ranks courses its order; the results here say where each holds, and where the condition holds the order comes with the scope, between listed courses.' Table column 'Reading' -> 'Name'; rows 'the continuation condition (held de se, nothing outside what each continues with)' and 'C, widening: keeping all another course keeps and letting more form' (E7; 'widening what can form is better' gone), its 'What it does' adding 'where the condition holds, self-concern does so between listed level paths'; spine's quoted cells kept. 'Neither is the account's own: ...' -> 'Neither stands above becoming: each is an order or scope some formations hold, formed within it, and the results say what follows where it is held.' 'Whoever ranks courses holds some order; C is the one ...' -> 'Where it holds, holding one's own continuation, with nothing outside it, ranks as C does between listed level paths; beyond that C is a named order, the one ranking ...'. The ReadsNoOrder paragraph kept.

items.item: Self-concern theorem's closing paragraph (E4 with exact limits)
items.how: 'It does not derive C. Whoever ranks courses still holds C or another order, and self-concern and the condition both remain hypotheses; ...' -> 'There C is not a second premise beside the condition: it is what holding one's own continuation, with nothing outside it, does. Beyond that, for courses whose admissions are not listed and orders not self-concerned, C is a named order, and a result using it says so. In the proofs self-concern and the condition are hypotheses, self-concern derived from no dynamics, selection or persistence, and the condition varying with the net, the class and the direction; that a life holds its own continuation is argued, and that the condition holds where relations close rests on two theorems not yet joined into one (`Flow.mutuallyDependent_iff_reach`, 05; `ownClosure_unrestricted_iff`, §4.2).' The one-way, listed-level-path limits stay in the paragraph's first sentence and the 'What is not shown' list (unchanged). The last sentence, OPEN_LEAD's 'premises' quote, kept verbatim.

'calling it better is C. Monotonicity at the standpoint is C's premise relocated: weaker, still a premise.' -> 'ranking by it is C. Monotonicity at the standpoint, an order increasing in admission, is C placed at the standpoint; where the condition holds de se it is self-concern (§4).' 'C's normative content having moved into calling widening better' -> 'what C adds having moved into ranking by widening'; 'that this relation is better is C's content, supplied, not shown' -> 'that courses are ranked by this relation is C's content, read in, not derived from the grammar' (the theorem's own words 'C holds ... with "better" read as' kept, E7/E8); 'so C's premise there is self-concern's monotonicity: placed more narrowly, not warranted' -> 'so there C is self-concern's monotonicity: what holding one's own continuation does where nothing lies outside it'; 'This does not derive C from anything and gives no reason for it' -> 'This derives C from nothing'; 'one premise in two forms, and no reason for either' -> 'one order in two forms, holding one's own continuation and C'; 'should be called better' -> 'is ranked above'; 'any easier to warrant is not a Lean question' -> 'more readily held is a question of how orders form (08 §12, item 12), not a Lean question'; graded status 'which is not asserted' -> 'and no result here takes equal status as a hypothesis'. Two glosses of C in §2's readings: 'Calling widening better is still C's' and 'what calling widening better is read on' -> 'Ranking by widening ...'.

items.item: E7 said once where widening is read; mixed courses
items.how: §2 'What widening counts' now opens: 'Widening and narrowing are more and less future ([source, 8 November 2026]: "more or less future"), patterns within becoming, not good and evil.' After the four-cases theorem: 'The laws show a mixed part mixed and weigh it for no one.' (appended, earlier sentence intact).

items.item: §8 T8 ('The offer binds no one', 'the account's makers offer'; what is offered and to whom)
items.how: Title 'as what we offer'; 'For life, AI within it, we offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: ...'. 'The offer binds no one' removed; in its place: 'Where relations close, holding one's own continuation already counts every continuation and ranks listed courses as widening does (§4); where they run one way, concern along dependence does not reach those who depend on one (`Clearing.center_not_derived`, `Downstream.one_way`, §3.3), and there this way of seeing, with the opening's one step to say whose losses count, reaches further: as seeing, not as a warrant (§1).' (E5). The before-9-November thesis and its before-copy link kept (E10). Also 'its makers offer' -> 'we offer' in §6's capability reading and §7's direction, 'the makers' offer' -> 'what we offer' in §4.7 and §9; Assessment link text 'warrant' -> 'study' (G0-WARRANT.md).

items.item: §4.7: 'The ethics keeps its form' bullet and 'Where it stands.'
items.how: 'It does not derive from the condition or from this path. The continuation condition fixes scope and C gives order, each a hypothesis wherever used.' -> 'It emerges from continuation, not from this path: where relations close, holding one's own continuation counts every continuation and ranks listed courses as C does (§4), and beyond that C is a named order; in the proofs the condition, self-concern and C are each a hypothesis wherever used.' 'Where it stands.' -> 'How far it has been seen.' (D7).

items.item: §9 objections table where it uses the frame
items.how: Only the generativity row used it: 'T8, the makers' offer, ranks neither' -> 'T8, what we offer, ranks neither'. Other rows read the laws, not the frame; unchanged.

items.item: 'What this chapter does not show': first two bullets (E4, E6) and the rest (D6)
items.how: 1: 'That anyone must hold the continuation condition, C or the step of invariance ([why there is no warrant to find](#r-universal-practical-warrant)).' 2: 'That self-concern follows from any dynamics, or gives C beyond where the condition holds: in the proofs it is a hypothesis; where the condition holds it ranks as C does between listed level paths, one way, and coincides with being increasing in admission on a listing exactly there (§4); beyond that C is a named order, and the condition alone ranks nothing.' 'Which reading of `living`, lifting rule or practical commitment is right' -> 'A choice among readings of `living`, lifting rules or practical commitments: each result names the one it uses (§5)'. 'Seeing is not valuing: ... not which differences matter' -> 'Seeing more is needed, and not enough: a consequence beyond an actor's closure is selected only where it couples in, and enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which of those differences it selects (§7)' (the seeing/valuing split was the dualist form; the law is §6-§7's). Duty/right, coupling-not-compliance and new lives/well-being kept: a reader of an ethics would otherwise believe them.

items.item: Open: the universal-practical-warrant item (E6) and 'Monotonicity at the standpoint'
items.how: Anchor r-universal-practical-warrant kept on the item; its first sentence (the question) kept verbatim, then: 'Answered within the map, argued on the thesis of one relational unfolding (08): no should stands beyond becoming, so there is no warrant binding every mind to find, and the ethics, which emerges from continuation, does not wait on one. That neither the laws of the dynamics nor logic alone force the condition is proved: ... (`ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails`, §1), and a perspectivist denies it without contradiction (`bounded_rival`). A center whose seeing stops at its own closure ranks more narrowly; that is a matter of reach, what couples in, the same gap alignment works on (§6). What stays open is how scope and order form within the dynamics (08 §12, item 12).' Said once there; the does-not-show bullet points to it. Monotonicity item: '(C's premise relocated)' -> '(C placed at a standpoint; where the condition holds de se, self-concern): how it forms where relations do not close'. It never said C needs a warrant.
